title: Wow! Hello, Biscuit! 🐶 Be Kind to Animals with Baby Ava | Gentle Hands | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! Biscuit the puppy bounces up to say hello to Baby Ava in the backyard! 🐶 Sing along with Ava and learn three kind ways to care for a pet – gentle hands, fresh water and playtime.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Biscuit! Hello, puppy!"
🤲 Gentle hands! Soft, soft pat!
💧 Fresh water for you! Slurp, slurp, slurp!
🔴 Here is your ball! Roll, roll, roll!
👏 Be kind, be kind! Soft hands with me – pat, pat, pat!
🤔 "How do we pet a puppy?" – GENTLY! Soft hands! Yay!
👋 Be kind to animals! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: being kind to animals • gentle hands • soft • kind • caring for a pet (water and play)

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun kindness song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Ava sits on the grass with her puppy Biscuit, pets him gently, gives him fresh water and plays ball with him, then asks you how we pet a puppy. After watching, practice soft, gentle hands with a teddy or your own pet!
